long_biography.plain_text:
Optical entrepreneur Dino Tabacchi saw a future in shops while visiting low-cost eyewear suppliers in Hong Kong. When his brothers rejected an American entrepreneur's proposal to enter British retailing, he pursued the venture separately. Vision Express combined large stores in shopping centres with one-hour service and television advertising. As the network expanded, an American investment fund supplied capital for further openings.

At LILT Padova, the cancer-prevention association he has chaired since 2010, Tabacchi has championed taking examinations into public squares. Its mobile clinic brings doctors closer to people who may not otherwise seek preventive care. The association also provides psychological support for patients, relatives and caregivers.
